**STACKS OF FIBER FUNCTORS AND TANNAKA’S RECONSTRUCTION**

*FABIO TONINI*

28 pp, 15 sections.

**Abstract.** Given a quasi-compact category ﬁbered in groupoids X and a monoidal subcat- egory C of its category of locally free sheaves Vect(X), we are going to introduce the stack of ﬁber functors FibX,C with source C, which comes equipped with a map PC : X →FibX,C and a functor G : C →Vect(FibX,C). If C generates QCoh(X) and X is an fpqc stack with quasi-aﬃne diagonal, we show that PC : X →FibX,C is an equivalence, as it happens by Tannaka’s reconstruction when X is an aﬃne gerbe over a ﬁeld. In general, under mild assumption on C, e.g. C = Vect(X), we show that FibX,C is a quasi-compact fpqc stack with aﬃne diagonal and that the image G(C) generates QCoh(FibX,C).

**Outline.** Front matter; Introduction; Notation; Acknowledgments; 1 Preliminaries; 1.1 Monoidal functors and their sheafification; 1.2 Generalized frame bundles; 2 Pseudo-affine stacks; 3 Tannaka Reconstruction; 4 Pseudo-Affine sheaves revisited; 5 The stack of fiber functors; 5.1 Proof of Theorem 5.1; 5.2 Comparing vector bundles; 5.3 The case C={OX}; References
